name: Isaac Gym / Isaac Lab
summary: Isaac Gym keeps simulation state entirely on the GPU, eliminating CPU-GPU transfer and enabling thousands of parallel environments on a single card. Tasks that previously needed a CPU cluster train in minutes to hours on one workstation. Isaac Lab is the current successor built on Isaac Sim, and it underpins NVIDIA's humanoid and manipulation model training.
innovation: An end-to-end GPU pipeline for physics, observation and policy update with no host round-trip.
Made massively parallel PPO the standard recipe for sim-trained robot control.
matters: The compute substrate behind most modern sim-to-real dexterity and humanoid work.
limits: Contact fidelity trades off against speed, and it is tightly coupled to NVIDIA hardware.
lineage: MuJoCo-era simulation reimplemented for massively parallel GPU execution.
